name: New Start
overview: The Scriptures reveal that a new start is rooted in trusting the LORD wholeheartedly rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 instructs. Isaiah emphasizes God's promise to renew strength and enable His people to rise above weariness, assuring them of His sustaining presence and help (Isaiah 40:31; 41:10). Moreover, God calls His people to forget former things and embrace the new work He is doing, making a way in desolate places and creating new heavens and a new earth where the past will no longer burden the heart (Isaiah 43:18-19; 65:17). This biblical perspective affirms that a new start is a divine renewal marked by trust, strength, and the transformative power of God’s ongoing creative work.
